package.name: aav_lane_finder_learned
package.description: The learned lane_finder (TODO 262b), a challenger (lane_finder_impl:=learned): our UFLD-v2-style model, trained on Ravensim's pictures labelled from the lane map, through ONNX Runtime (the ort crate): Core ML on a Mac, the CPU anywhere, TensorRT on the Orin (untested). The same topics and message as the classic finder: the front left camera's pictures and camera_info in; /perception/lane/geometry out, its lines fitted by lane-core. The maths is the ufld-core crate, with no ROS.
